note: The province as a raster. `base_dm` is the low-frequency landform in decimetres on a 25 m grid; the game adds game/src/world/noise.js detailAt(x,z,relief,ridge,terrace) analytically, so ground height is continuous and identical in the builder and at runtime. `woff_cm` is the standing-water table above the base surface: depth = (base + woff) - ground, which is why RI-WLD10 §8's coverage index could be SOLVED for rather than asserted.
